exposure: immigrant status (first generation, second- and third-generation, non-immigrant)
cohort: Women who gave birth at three Berlin obstetric hospitals in 2011/2012
finding: No significant differences were found in caesarean section rates, indications for caesarean section delivery, or neonatal outcomes between immigrants, their offspring, and non-immigrants, with the exception of a slightly higher rate of crash caesarean sections among first-generation immigrants.
mod_finding: The study found a slightly higher rate of emergency caesarean sections among first-generation immigrants compared to non-immigrants.
